_comment: Fingerprints of the build this mod was developed and verified against. tools/check-after-update.ps1 compares the installed game to these and reports what needs re-checking. Update the values here after re-verifying against a new build.

signature_anchor._comment: Three of the four UE4SS_Signatures files derive the image base from this anchor and then jump to a hardcoded absolute RVA. Those RVAs are valid only for the exe above.

sound_classes._comment: Authored volumes captured from the verified build. If a patch rebalances the mix these change, and a stale baseline file would apply the boost to the wrong base.
